spec.description: Retrieve a list of withdrawal addresses available for the user. Requires the `Funds permissions - Query` and `Funds permissions - Withdraw` API key permissions.

asset.description: Filter addresses for a specific asset.

aclass.description: Filter addresses for a specific asset class.

method.description: Filter addresses for a specific method.

key.description: Find the address set up under this withdrawal key name.

verified.description: Filter by verification status. Withdrawal addresses that have successfully completed email confirmation have a verification status of `true`.

response.title: WithdrawAddressesFrame
response.description: Wire frame; the generated method returns `result`.

error.description: Wire envelope field; see the core.

result.description: Withdrawal addresses available for the user.

items.title: WithdrawalAddress
items.description: One withdrawal address available for the user.

key.description: Withdrawal key name, as set up on the account.

tag.description: Tag for XRP, or memo for STX/XLM/EOS, deposit addresses associated with this withdrawal address.

verified.description: Verification status of the withdrawal address.

notes: Upstream `requestBody` requires `nonce`; dropped from this schema since the core's `authed_request` (`core/transport/http.py`) injects a strictly-increasing nonce into every private call automatically -- it is never a caller-supplied parameter, matching the existing hand-written `deposit_methods(self, asset)` signature, which takes none.
